Multiplayer-like action with bots, complete with avatars and turn-based gameplay. 
Gameplay:

Four players square off, each receiving a deck of 52 cards.
The game spans five rounds, each with its own scoring.
Every round comprises 13 deals, involving all four players.
In each deal, players take turns playing one card, resulting in four cards per deal.
A round concludes after 13 deals, and a full game consists of five rounds. 
Objective:

Your goal is to outbid and outplay your opponents. 
Bidding and Playing:

The 52 cards are distributed counterclockwise among the players.
After receiving their cards, players declare their bids (Call) for the round. The Call represents how many deals they aim to win in that round.
Calls range from 1 to 8 and depend on the player's hand.
Your strategy: Make your bid based on your cards! 
Dealing and Winning:

Dealing starts with the player to the right of the dealer, who plays the first card.
Subsequently, each player plays one card per turn.
The player who plays the next card aims to win the deal by playing a higher-ranking card.
The winner leads the next deal.
Players must follow suit or play a trump card if they can't match the suit.
The player with the most won deals after five rounds wins the game! 
Card Hierarchy:

Cards rank from highest to lowest: A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3-2.
Spades are the designated trump suit in Callbreak.
